ei.title: A Universal Language in Global Traditional Games
ei.subject: 세계문화와영어비상

fullPassage: Across the world, unique cultures and traditions shape societies and identities. Yet, in this diversity, traditional games and activities stand as a universal bond that breaks boundaries. These games often highlight the shared aspects of cultures, breaking through languages and cultural barriers. A good example of traditional games is the game of "Tag", a popular playground game enjoyed in numerous countries, including the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, India, South Korea, Japan, Germany, and France. In this game, one player is designated as "It" and tries to tag others. When someone is tagged, the tagger says, "Tag, you're It!" He or she becomes the new "It," continuing the game and taking turns being the chaser. "Jump Rope" is another universally loved game. Two participants swing a jump rope, while others jump over it as the rope rotates. This game is popular in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, China, Japan, South Korea, Thailand, India, Africa, and Europe, showing the global appeal of this simple yet engaging activity. "Marbles" involves throwing small glass marbles on the ground to strike and win your opponents' marbles. This game is loved in countries like the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, and Australia, each region having its own variation of rules and game play. And let's not forget "Hide and Seek", a game enjoyed by children and adults alike. This game is played in various countries such as the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, India, Japan, South Korea, Germany, France, China, Brazil, Mexico, Africa, and Europe. In this game, one person becomes "It," while others become "Hiders" to start the game. The game offers the thrill of finding the "Hiders" and the excitement of a chase. Traditional games may be a powerful tool for connecting people worldwide. Regardless of language and culture, they probably unite individuals and provide a platform for discovering common ground. Moreover, they foster cross-cultural understanding. Though these games may vary slightly in rules and names by region, they bring joy to people around the world and form unique cultural traditions.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
① enjoyed: a popular playground game enjoyed in numerous countries — 명사를 뒤에서 꾸미는 과거분사(즐겨지는) 적절
② try → tries: 주어 one player(단수)가 is designated와 and로 병렬 연결된 3인칭 단수 현재 동사이므로 tries가 맞음 ← 정답
③ continuing: 콤마 뒤에서 '게임을 이어 가면서'를 나타내는 분사구문으로 적절
④ loved: another universally loved game — 명사를 꾸미는 과거분사(사랑받는) 적절
det.tip: 주어 one player는 단수입니다. is designated ... and tries처럼 동사의 수를 맞춰야 합니다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
① plays → is played: 게임은 사람들에 의해 행해지는 대상이므로 수동태 is played가 맞음. This game plays는 능동이라 부적절 ← 정답
② others become: 주어 others(복수) + 동사원형 become 수일치 적절
③ start: to start the game — 목적을 나타내는 to부정사에서 to 뒤 동사원형 적절
④ finding: the thrill of finding — 전치사 of 뒤 동명사 적절
det.tip: 게임이 스스로 노는 것이 아니라 '행해지는' 것이므로 수동태(be + p.p.)가 필요합니다.

questions.passage: Two participants ①<u>swing</u> a jump rope, while others jump over it as the rope rotates. This game is popular in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, China, Japan, South Korea, Thailand, India, Africa, and Europe, ②<u>showing</u> the global appeal of this simple yet engaging activity. "Marbles" ③<u>involve</u> throwing small glass marbles on the ground ④<u>to strike</u> and win your opponents' marbles. This game is loved in countries like the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, and Australia, each region having its own variation of rules and game play. And let's not forget "Hide and Seek", a game enjoyed by children and adults alike.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.analysis:
① swing: 주어 Two participants(복수) + swing 수일치 적절
② showing: 콤마 뒤에서 '~을 보여 주면서'를 나타내는 분사구문으로 적절
③ involve → involves: 주어 "Marbles"는 게임 이름 하나를 가리키는 단수 취급이므로 3인칭 단수 involves가 맞음 ← 정답
④ to strike: 목적(치기 위해)을 나타내는 to부정사로 적절
det.tip: 게임 이름("Marbles")은 -s로 끝나도 하나의 게임을 가리키는 단수 취급입니다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

③ breaking: '언어와 문화 장벽을 뚫으면서'를 나타내는 분사구문으로 적절
④ designates → is designated: 한 명의 참가자가 술래로 '지정되는' 대상이므로 수동태 is designated가 맞음. designates는 능동이라 부적절 ← 정답
det.tip: designate(지정하다)의 주체는 사람들이고 one player는 지정을 '당하는' 쪽이므로 수동태가 필요합니다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.analysis:
① boredom(지루함) → thrill(스릴): 뒤에 the excitement of a chase(추격의 흥분)가 병렬로 이어지므로 숨은 사람을 찾는 '스릴'이 맞음. 지루함은 흥분과 모순 ← 정답
② excitement: 추격이 주는 '흥분'이라는 문맥에 적절
③ powerful: 사람들을 연결하는 '강력한' 도구라는 문맥에 적절
④ unite: 언어와 문화에 상관없이 사람들을 '결속시킨다'는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: and로 연결된 the excitement(흥분)와 어울리는 감정은 boredom(지루함)이 아니라 thrill(스릴)입니다.

det.analysis:

④ various: 숨바꼭질이 '다양한' 나라에서 행해진다는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: 앞의 인기 나열과 어울리는 말은 rejection(거부)이 아니라 appeal(매력)입니다.

questions.passage: Across the world, unique cultures and traditions shape societies and identities. Yet, in this diversity, traditional games and activities stand as a universal bond that breaks boundaries. These games often highlight the shared aspects of cultures, breaking through languages and cultural barriers. A good example of traditional games is the game of "Tag", a popular playground game enjoyed in numerous countries, including the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, India, South Korea, Japan, Germany, and France. In this game, one player is designated as "It" and tries to tag others. When someone is tagged, the tagger says, "Tag, you're It!" He or she becomes the new "It," continuing the game and taking turns being the chaser. "Jump Rope" is another universally loved game. Two participants swing a jump rope, while others jump over it as the rope rotates. This game is popular in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, China, Japan, South Korea, Thailand, India, Africa, and Europe, showing the global appeal of this simple yet engaging activity. "Marbles" involves throwing small glass marbles on the ground to strike and win your opponents' marbles. This game is loved in countries like the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, and Australia, each region having its own variation of rules and game play. And let's not forget "Hide and Seek", a game enjoyed by children and adults alike.

det.analysis:

det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- Traditional games(주어) + may be(조동사 + be동사): ~일지도 모른다, ~이 될 수 있다
- a powerful tool(보어): 강력한 도구
- for connecting people worldwide: 전치사 for + 동명사 connecting — '전 세계 사람들을 연결하기 위한'
- worldwide는 '전 세계에서'라는 부사로 문장 끝에 위치
det.tip: may be(~일 수 있다) + 명사 보어, 그리고 전치사 for 뒤에는 동명사(connecting)가 옵니다.
